title: I should have looked at the sizes
text: I should have looked at the sizes. The product itself is very durable and easy to clean but I should have looked at the sizes. None of them are big enough to cover a full plate.

product_metadata.title: Simply Served Variety Pack Steam Vents Microwave Splatter Covers, Clear
features: KEEP YOUR MICROWAVE CLEAN: Cook food quickly and cleanly. With 5 different sizes to choose from, you will always have the right cover for what you're cooking.
SPACE-SAVING KITCHEN ACCESSORY: These innovative microwave covers nest together to economize valuable kitchen storage space.
ADJUSTABLE STEAM VENTS: Use the adjustable steam vents in each of the covers to ensure your food doesn't getting soggy or dry.
DISHWASHER SAFE: All of the covers are BPA-free and safe to be washed in the top rack of your dishwasher.

DIMENSIONS: Extra Small: 4. 5" diameter, 1. 125" height; Small: 5. 625" diameter; 1. 5" height; Medium: 6. 625" diameter; 1. 625" height; Large: 7. 75" diameter; 2" height; Extra Large: 9" diameter; 2. 25" height
description: Keep your microwave clean and reduce messy splatters by using one of the five covers in this set when microwaving leftovers. Each cover has an adjustable steam vent to allow you to prevent both sogginess and dryness when reheating food. BPA-Free. Top rack dishwasher safe.
